title: A Home on Four Wheels
paras: Welcome to our exhibition about a very small travelling home. In 1985, Rosa and Karim built this home inside an old van. They wanted to visit mountain villages and paint pictures of life there. The [[result|result]] was a house that could move from place to place. Walk around it first. Notice the thick [[rubber|rubber]] tyres and the little blue [[mailbox|mailbox]] beside the door. Visitors left letters for the couple in this box.

Now look inside through the open door. There is a bed, a cooking area and even a tiny [[bathtub|bathtub]]. After a day of [[driving|driving]], Karim liked a warm wash. Rosa had a different [[habit|habit]]: she drew the view before dinner every evening. Her pencils are in the top [[drawer|drawer]] under the table. Beside them is a smooth white [[rock|rock]] from their first mountain stop. They used it to keep their paper still on windy days.

At the final table, you can [[mix|mix]] blue and yellow paint to make the green of their van. A computer nearby shows their route. Use its [[keyboard|keyboard]] to type a village name and find their paintings. Before you leave, look back at the van: this little room carried a whole life of travel.
zh: 欢迎参观我们关于一座小小的移动住宅的展览。1985年，罗莎和卡里姆在一辆旧厢式货车里建起了这个家。他们想去山村旅行，用画笔记录那里的生活。于是，一座可以四处移动的房子就这样诞生了。请先绕着车走一圈，看看厚实的橡胶轮胎和车门旁蓝色的小信箱。来访的人会把写给这对夫妇的信放进这个箱子里。
现在，请透过敞开的车门看看里面。这里有一张床、一处做饭的地方，甚至还有一个小浴缸。开了一天车后，卡里姆喜欢用温水洗个澡。罗莎则有另一个习惯：每天傍晚吃饭前，她都会画下眼前的景色。她的铅笔放在桌子下面最上层的抽屉里。铅笔旁边有一块光滑的白色石头，来自他们第一次在山里停留的地方。刮风的时候，他们就用它压住画纸。
在最后一张桌子上，你可以把蓝色和黄色颜料混合，调出他们那辆车的绿色。旁边的一台电脑展示着他们的旅行路线。用键盘输入一个村庄的名字，就能找到他们的画作。离开之前，请再回头看看这辆车：这个小小的房间，承载着他们四处旅行的整个生活。

q.s: Rosa and Karim paid less than £1,000 for the van.
q.why: 文中未说明购买货车的价格。

q.s: Rosa drew the view before dinner every evening.
q.why: 文中明确说她每天晚饭前画风景。

q.s: The computer does not show the couple’s route.
q.why: 文中明确说电脑展示他们的旅行路线。
